item_title: DORA, EU AI Act, da Ikon Mallakar Bayanai: Tarin Bin Doka na 2026 ga Bankuna
excerpt: DORA, EU AI Act, GDPR, haɗarin tarawar cloud, da ikon mallakar bayanai sun haɗu zuwa tarin bin doka guda na bankuna a 2026.
